resourceId.description: Foreign key to resources.resourceId — the identity this chain loads

path.description: Root-relative path of the loaded file

loadClass.description: "always" (loaded at session start) or "on-demand" (loaded when the agent touches a matching file)

admissionKind.description: Kind of the DECIDING admission, or null when nothing admitted this row: "ancestry", "root-rule", "nested-rule", "glob-rule", "glob-rule-covers-dir", "glob-rule-may-fire", "import"

pattern.description: The deciding admission's distinguishing string — a glob, a directory, or a closure root; null where its kind has none

depth.description: Import hops from the closure root, for an `import` admission VAT could attribute; null otherwise

admissionCount.description: How many admissions this row carries — the deciding one is a summary of them, not the whole list

sizeCliff.description: The 4 MiB CLAUDE.md cliff's verdict on this file — NOT whether it is paid at launch; that is launchCharge. "unmeasured" means no blob, so no size

launchCharge.description: Whether this row's bytes are paid when a session starts — sum tokens or bytes WHERE this is "charged". Open vocabulary: "charged", "unknown-size", "oversize", "not-always"

tokens.description: blobs.tokenEstimate, or null when this realization has no blob. Null is UNKNOWN, never zero

bytes.description: blobs.bytes, or null when this realization has no blob

projection-claude-context-loads.description: A row of the derived `claude_context_loads` relation
